name: Quebec City (Canada)
description: A blue field bordered in gold, charged with a golden sailing ship — Champlain's Don-de-Dieu — on a silver wave.
history: Adopted in 1987 from the city arms; the ship is Champlain's Don-de-Dieu, the wall-like border the ramparts of North America's only walled city north of Mexico.

features.symbolism: Samuel de Champlain's ship, which brought the city's founder in 1608
